title: מי מייצר את הריח של הגשם הראשון
summary: Why the first rain smells (petrichor): plant oil stored in dry dust and geosmin from Streptomyces (Bear & Thomas 1964), the MIT 2015 bubble/aerosol mechanism, the nose's ~100 ppt sensitivity (a teaspoon in 20 Olympic pools, 10,000x a shark), springtails as the evolutionary reason (2020), Kannauj mitti attar, and Israel's yoreh and the Mishna's rain calendar.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: Arto tip briefly overlays a canvas corner on phones; 'אוכל' tag now drawn last; older track runs ~30 min for slow readers
